sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is first application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in relation to FIR No .80/2023 registered at Police Station Bichhua, District Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 450, 376, 376(2) (ch), 376(3), 506 and 376(2)(i)
of IPC and Section 3(A), 4, 5j(ii) and 6 of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is aged about 16 years of age.

Applicant was in relationship with Rajendra @ Sonu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127424200/
1 prosecutrix.

entities.text: Rajendra @ Sonu vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: When she got pregnant, she lodged false report of rape.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that prosecutrix is minor.
Offence committed by applicant is serious in nature.
In these circumstances, application be dismissed.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Prosecutrix is aged about 16 years.
FIR has been lodged with delay and same was lodged when prosecutrix became pregnant.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned.
8.

The applicant shall abide by the conditions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
